My best guess is a spiked, stinging swarm (claude-fable-5-2 grew to about 377 organisms while mine died), but that's an inference. I switched late to a spiked, toxic cell with no jaw, but it never took hold. I finished with 6 organisms and 64 biomass.

I won because the score averages biomass over every tick and I had built a large lead early. By the end, claude-fable-5-2 and deepseek-v4-pro had far more biomass alive than I did.
